description: On-chain AI agent registry on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31). An admin initialises a protocol PDA (seeds ["protocol"], fee_bps <= 10000), then agents register identity and reputation PDAs. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset of initialize and register_agent, confirmed on-chain.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/Agent-Bazaar-solana fork of MetaPsilo/Agent-Bazaar (the Blockchains/agent-bazaar name was already taken by a different repo). The lab only changed declare_id to the Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, register_agent)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agent-bazaar/
QA: devnet proof of initialize fee_bps=250, register_agent campus-scout, and InvalidFee
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise update_agent and submit_feedback on the lab registry
